experiment_name: DDQN training bit-exact reproducibility check (two independent 20-game runs, same seed)

algorithm_config.compared_against: 002-ddqn-20-game-training-smoke's checkpoint (same command, independent process, min-available-gib lowered only due to ambient system RAM, not a training parameter change)

compared_fields: deterministic history fields (win_rates, rewards, trade/property counters, games-completed counters)

result: Reproducibility PASSED: every compared field was bit-identical (torch.equal, not a tolerance) between two independent 20-game training runs with the same seed. Raw checkpoint file SHA-256 differed between the two runs despite the content match - this is expected torch.save pickle/zip container non-determinism, not a reproducibility failure; file hash is therefore not a valid reproducibility check for these .pt files. Cleared the way to resume training to 500 games (see 004).
notes: wall_time_s/peak_rss_gib are null because this entry is about the comparison result, not a single run's own runtime (see 004 for the actual training run's runtime that this reproducibility check validated the trainer against). crashes=2 refers to two memory-watchdog interruptions hit before the user authorized --min-available-gib 1 for this specific retry (system RAM pressure from other applications, not an engine/training bug) - see docs/EXPERIMENTS.md 2026-08-11 entry for the exact errors.
